entries.label: ITEMINFO_1120

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1129
entries.text: A candy that is packed with energy. If consumed, it raises\nthe Dynamax Level of a Pokémon by one. A higher level\nmeans higher HP when Dynamaxed.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1130
entries.text: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit.\nThis sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1131
entries.text: The user drops onto the target with its full body\nweight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1132
entries.text: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire.\nThis may also leave the target with a burn.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1133
entries.text: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water\nlaunched under great pressure.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1134
entries.text: The user attacks everything around it by swamping\nits surroundings with a giant wave.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1135
entries.text: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy.\nThis may also leave the target frozen.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1136
entries.text: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing\nPokémon. This may also leave the opposing\nPokémon frozen.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1137
entries.text: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over.\nThe heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1138
entries.text: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target.\nThis may also leave the target with paralysis.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1139
entries.text: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to\ninflict damage. This may also leave the target\nwith paralysis.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1140
entries.text: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every\nPokémon around it.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1141
entries.text: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force.\nThis may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1142
entries.text: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move\nfaster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1143
entries.text: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that\ncritical hits land more easily.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1144
entries.text: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain\ninto randomly using nearly any move.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1145
entries.text: The target is attacked with an intense blast of\nall-consuming fire. This may also leave the target\nwith a burn.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1146
entries.text: The user charges at the target and may make\nit flinch.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1147
entries.text: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its\nconcerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1148
entries.text: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is\nrestored by half the damage taken by the target.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1149
entries.text: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack.\nThis may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1150
entries.text: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of\nits own HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1151
entries.text: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the\nless HP the user has.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1152
entries.text: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may\nalso poison the target.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1153
entries.text: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing\nteam’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch\ninto battle.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1154
entries.text: The user rampages and attacks for two to three\nturns. The user then becomes confused.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1155
entries.text: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack\nthe target. This attack does physical damage.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1156
entries.text: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP.\nIts chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1157
entries.text: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the\nmoves it knows.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1158
entries.text: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams\ninto the target with no letup.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1159
entries.text: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in\nwaiting and passes along any stat changes.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1160
entries.text: The user compels the target to keep using the move\nit encored for three turns.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1161
entries.text: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail.\nThis may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1162
entries.text: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs.\nThis may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1163
entries.text: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target.\nThis may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1164
entries.text: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic\nenergy attacks the target.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1165
entries.text: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns.\nDuring that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1166
entries.text: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing\nPokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with\na burn.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1167
entries.text: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use\nonly attack moves for three turns.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1168
entries.text: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its\nheld item with its own.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1169
entries.text: The user attacks the target with great power.\nHowever, this also lowers the user’s Attack and\nDefense stats.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1170
entries.text: The user employs its psychic power to exchange\nAbilities with the target.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1171
entries.text: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit\nmore easily. This may also leave the target with\na burn.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1172
entries.text: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with\nthe power to inflict damage.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1173
entries.text: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s\nrecoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1174
entries.text: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to\nraise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1175
entries.text: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing\nPokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1176
entries.text: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron,\nsharply raising its Defense stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1177
entries.text: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1178
entries.text: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body,\nraising both its Attack and Defense stats.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1179
entries.text: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its\nspirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1180
entries.text: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and\nattacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land\nmore easily.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1181
entries.text: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful\ndance that raises its Attack and Speed stats.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1182
entries.text: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin.\nThe slower the user compared to the target, the\ngreater the move’s power.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1183
entries.text: The user fights the target up close without guarding\nitself. This also lowers the user’s Defense and\nSp. Def stats.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1184
entries.text: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of\nthe opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing\nPokémon that switch into battle.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1185
entries.text: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target.\nThis also damages the user quite a lot. This attack\nmay leave the target with a burn.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1186
entries.text: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep\nwithin its body at the target. This attack\nnever misses.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1187
entries.text: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like\nsteeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1188
entries.text: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark\nthoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1189
entries.text: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds\ndown on the target from above.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1190
entries.text: The user slashes at the target by crossing its\nscythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1191
entries.text: The user generates a damaging sound wave by\nvibration. This may also lower the target’s\nSp. Def stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1192
entries.text: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated\nby the user’s gaping mouth.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1193
entries.text: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as\nif it were made of gemstones.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1194
entries.text: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes\nits power. This may also lower the target’s\nSp. Def stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1195
entries.text: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the\ntarget. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1196
entries.text: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low\naltitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1197
entries.text: The user makes the ground under the target erupt\nwith power. This may also lower the target’s\nSp. Def stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1198
entries.text: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad\nthoughts. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1199
entries.text: The user focuses its willpower to its head and\nattacks the target. This may also make the\ntarget flinch.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1200
entries.text: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it\nall at once. This may also lower the target’s\nSp. Def stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1201
entries.text: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the\ntarget. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s\nSp. Atk stat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1202
entries.text: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the\nlike to harshly lash the target.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1203
entries.text: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to\nattack. This may also poison the target.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1204
entries.text: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head.\nThis may also make the target flinch.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1205
entries.text: The user stabs the target from below with\nsharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1206
entries.text: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the\nopposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon\nthat switch into battle.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1207
entries.text: The user snares the target with grass and trips it.\nThe heavier the target, the greater the\nmove’s power.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1208
entries.text: The user strikes everything around it by swamping\nthe area with a giant sludge wave. This may also\npoison those hit.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1209
entries.text: The user slams into the target with its heavy body.\nThe more the user outweighs the target, the greater\nthe move’s power.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1210
entries.text: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The\nfaster the user is than the target, the greater the\nmove’s power.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1211
entries.text: The user turns the target’s power against it.\nThe higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater\nthe damage it deals.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1212
entries.text: The user attacks the target with stored power.\nThe more the user’s stats are raised, the greater\nthe move’s power.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1213
entries.text: The user teleports using a strange power and\nswitches places with one of its allies.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1214
entries.text: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target.\nThis may also leave the target with a burn.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1215
entries.text: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk\nstats increase.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1216
entries.text: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes\ninto its target. This also damages the user a little.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1217
entries.text: The user crashes into its target while rotating its\nbody like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1218

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1579
entries.text: Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this\nhoney to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also\nhas the same effect as a Max Revive.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1580
entries.text: Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax\nforms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1581
entries.text: A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows\nin certain areas around the Galar region. It’s a material\nfor an accessory for a certain Pokémon.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1582
entries.text: A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.\nGiving it to a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon\nvery happy.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1583
entries.text: Having one of these cards increases the selection\navailable to you in boutiques and hair salons.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1584
entries.text: A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail\nstaff at Wedgehurst Station.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1585
entries.text: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water\nusing Rotom’s power. It’s a sparkling white that\nshines brilliantly.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1586
entries.text: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water\nusing Rotom’s power. It’s a glistening black that\nshines reddish-black.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1587
entries.text: Having one of these charms increases the Exp. Points\nyour Pokémon get. It’s a strange, stretchy charm that\nencourages growth.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1588
entries.text: Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor.\nSomething good will happen if you give it to a collector\non the Isle of Armor.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1589
entries.text: Having one of these mysterious and unique charms\nmakes it more likely you’ll encounter a Pokémon with\na mark.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1590
entries.text: Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance\nCalyrex’s power over bountiful harvests and unite\nCalyrex with its beloved steed.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1591
entries.text: Reins that people presented to the king. They enable\nthose who are connected to communicate with each\nother. The reins separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1592
entries.text: A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.\nPlacing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes\nthe Pokémon very happy.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1593
entries.text: A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written\nby Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1594
entries.text: A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written\nby Peony and has unique drawings.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1595
entries.text: A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written\nby Peony and has a unique drawing.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1596
entries.text: A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped.\nThere’s a photo attached to it showing a shining hole\nopening above the Max Lair.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1597
entries.text: A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail\nstaff at Wedgehurst Station.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1598
entries.text: A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to\nbe chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1599
entries.text: A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests\ngave you. It radiates faint light.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1600
entries.text: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful\nHarvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong\nand very flexible.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1601
entries.text: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful\nHarvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very\nsmooth to the touch.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1602
entries.text: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved\nsteed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1603
entries.text: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved\nsteed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1604
entries.text: Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair.\nSomething good will happen if you give it to a\ncollector in the Crown Tundra.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1605
entries.text: Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is\ndetermined by which field you plant the seeds in.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1606
entries.text: A patch that can be used to change the regular Ability\nof a Pokémon to a rarer Ability.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1607
entries.text: Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light.\nThe people of old times presented these to the King of\nBountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1608
entries.text: A mysterious balm that somehow has the power to calm\nDialga in its frenzy.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1609
entries.text: A mysterious balm that somehow has the power to calm\nPalkia in its frenzy.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1610
entries.text: A mysterious balm to be used when battling Arceus.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1611
entries.text: A string exuding a mysterious energy that makes you\nfeel a strange sense of connection. It’s loved by\ncertain Pokémon.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1612
entries.text: A baked treat made from Berries and other ingredients,\nwhich is often eaten in regions such as Galar. It is\nbeloved by a surprising number of Pokémon.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1613
entries.text: A fruit whose shell can be used to form the capsules of\nall manner of Poké Balls when crafting them from\nscratch. Its proper name is actually “Brown Apricorn.”

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1614
entries.text: A hidden gem gaining popularity in Jubilife Village and\nbeloved by Pokémon. This sweet treat can be fed to\na Pokémon to cure any status condition it may have.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1615
entries.text: An item that sharply boosts the offensive and defensive\nstats of a Pokémon in battle. These effects disappear\nif the Pokémon leaves the battle.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1616
entries.text: An item that sharply boosts the critical-hit ratio of\na Pokémon in battle. This effect disappears if the\nPokémon leaves the battle.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1617
entries.text: A dumpling that will make a Pokémon become fixated on\na move in battle. The Pokémon will deal more damage\nwhen using that move but will take more damage as well.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1618
entries.text: These pickled vegetables prime a Pokémon for battle.\nThe Pokémon takes a hard-hitting stance, which boosts\nthe damage dealt by its moves by 50 percent.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1619
entries.text: When eaten, this curious snack temporarily swaps a\nPokémon’s offensive stats with its defensive stats.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1620
entries.text: A fern used for crafting items made to be thrown.\nWhen these curled leaves are unfurled, they can serve\nas nature’s wrapping paper.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1621
entries.text: A rare seed that can be given to the captain of the\nSecurity Corps to have a Pokémon master a move\nso it can be used in the agile style or strong style.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1624
entries.text: A type of ice beloved by the Lord of the Tundra,\nAvalugg. This ice is said to be fragments of ancient\nAvalugg that lived long ago.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1625
entries.text: Proof that you have completed the trial set by Uxie,\nthe Being of Knowledge that lives in Lake Acuity.\nThis item is needed to forge the Red Chain.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1626
entries.text: Proof that you have completed the trial set by Azelf,\nthe Being of Willpower that lives in Lake Valor.\nThis item is needed to forge the Red Chain.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1627
entries.text: Proof that you have completed the trial set by Mesprit,\nthe Being of Emotion that lives in Lake Verity.\nThis item is needed to forge the Red Chain.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1628
entries.text: When combined with an Apricorn, this mysterious\ntumbled stone can draw out the properties required\nto forge a Poké Ball.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1629
entries.text: A flute that can be used to call special Pokémon that\nare willing to bear you around the region. Its timbre is\neerie and mysterious.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1630
entries.text: An herbal medicine that can restore 60 HP to a\nPokémon, just as a Potion does. Yet the bitter taste\nwill make the Pokémon less friendly toward you.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1631
entries.text: An herbal medicine that can restore 100 HP to a\nPokémon, just as a Super Potion does. Yet the bitter taste\nwill make the Pokémon less friendly toward you.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1632
entries.text: Honey that sparkles with an amber hue. It is beloved\nby bug Pokémon and Pokémon with fairylike charms,\nso they will gather wherever a comb of it is thrown.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1633
entries.text: Beautiful stalks of rice bursting with life. Pokémon that\ndwell and wander among the fields love these grains and\nwill gather wherever the stalks are thrown.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1634
entries.text: Large, juicy beans that grow in pods. These beans are\nbeloved by fish Pokémon, as well as bird Pokémon and\ntheir flying ilk, so throw one and they will gather around.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1635
entries.text: A large and well-ripened mushroom. It is beloved by the\nmore monstrous Pokémon, as well as dragon Pokémon,\nso they will gather wherever one is thrown.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1636
entries.text: Translucent crystals that are beloved by Pokémon\nbearing a resemblance to grass, plants, or minerals.\nThey will gather wherever a lump of this salt is thrown.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1637
entries.text: A handy log of wood that can be used for anything,\nfrom crafting common goods needed for daily living\nto producing works of art.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1638
entries.text: The king of herbs, glittering and brilliant. Combining\nthis herb with other materials needed to make medicines\nwill boost their efficacy.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1639
entries.text: A mysterious balm that gives off a soothing scent.\nIt can be used to help calm the frenzy of the Lady of\nthe Ridge, Lilligant.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1640
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Poké Balls from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Apricorn and 1 Tumblestone.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1641
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Great Balls from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Apricorn, 1 Iron Chunk, and\n1 Tumblestone.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1642
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Ultra Balls from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Apricorn, 2 Iron Chunks, and\n2 Tumblestones.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1643
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Feather Balls from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Apricorn and 1 Sky Tumblestone.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1644
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Pokéshi Dolls from scratch.\nRequired materials: 3 logs of Wood.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1646
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Smoke Bombs from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Caster Fern leaf and\n1 Sootfoot Root.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1647
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Scatter Bangs from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Pop Pod and 1 Caster Fern leaf.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1648
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Sticky Globs from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Spoiled Apricorn, 1 Ball of Mud,\nand 1 Caster Fern leaf.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1649
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Star Pieces from scratch.\nRequired materials: 3 Red Shards, 3 Blue Shards,\n3 Green Shards, and 1 bag of Stardust.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1650
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Mushroom Cakes from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Springy Mushroom and\n1 Cake-Lure Base.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1651
entries.text: A wildflower that can be found growing across the Hisui\nregion. It does have medicinal properties, but it is\nso bitter that no wild Pokémon will eat it.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1652
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Honey Cakes from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 comb of Dazzling Honey and\n1 Cake-Lure Base.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1653
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Grain Cakes from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 stalk of Hearty Grains and\n1 Cake-Lure Base.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1654
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Bean Cakes from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 pod of Plump Beans and\n1 Cake-Lure Base.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1655
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Salt Cakes from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 hunk of Crunchy Salt and\n1 Cake-Lure Base.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1656
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Potions from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Oran Berry and 1 Medicinal Leek.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1657
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Super Potions from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Potion and 1 Pep-Up Plant.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1658
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Hyper Potions from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Super Potion and 1 Vivichoke.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1659
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Max Potions from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Sitrus Berry and 1 bunch of\nKing’s Leaf.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1660
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Full Restores from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Max Potion and 1 Full Heal.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1661
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Remedies from scratch.\nRequired materials: 2 Bugwort blooms.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1662
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Fine Remedies from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Remedy and 1 Pep-Up Plant.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1663
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Superb Remedies from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Fine Remedy and 1 Vivichoke.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1664
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Old Gateaux from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 pod of Plump Beans, 1 comb of\nDazzling Honey, 1 Sootfoot Root, and 1 Cake-Lure Base.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1665
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Jubilife Muffins from scratch.\nRequired materials: 2 stalks of Hearty Grains,\n2 Hopo Berries, 1 Razz Berry, and 1 Cake-Lure Base.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1666
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Full Heals from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Cheri Berry, 1 Pecha Berry,\n1 Rawst Berry, and 1 Aspear Berry.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1667
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Revives from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Vivichoke and 2 Medicinal Leeks.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1668
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Max Revives from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Revive and 2 bunches of\nKing’s Leaf.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1669
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Max Ethers from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Leppa Berry and 2 Pep-Up Plants.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1670
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Max Elixirs from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Max Ether and 2 bunches of\nKing’s Leaf.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1671
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Stealth Sprays from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Hopo Berry and\n3 Bugwort blooms.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1673
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Aux Powers from scratch.\nRequired materials: 2 bunches of Swordcap and\n1 Pep-Up Plant.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1674
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Aux Guards from scratch.\nRequired materials: 2 scraps of Iron Barktongue and\n1 Pep-Up Plant.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1675
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Dire Hits from scratch.\nRequired materials: 2 Direshrooms and 1 Candy Truffle.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1676
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Aux Evasions from scratch.\nRequired materials: 2 bunches of Doppel Bonnets and\n1 Candy Truffle.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1677
entries.text: A recipe for crafting Aux Powerguards from scratch.\nRequired materials: 1 Aux Power, 1 Aux Guard, and\n1 bunch of King’s Leaf.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1678
entries.text: A mysterious balm that gives off a soothing scent.\nIt can be used to help calm the frenzy of the Lord of\nthe Woods, Kleavor.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1679
entries.text: A naturally occurring hunk of iron. Such ore is needed\nto make the requisite parts of numerous Poké Ball\nvarieties, such as the clasp that holds the ball shut.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1681
entries.text: When combined with an Apricorn, this mysterious\nblack stone can draw out the properties required\nto forge a Heavy Ball.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1682
entries.text: When combined with an Apricorn, this mysterious\nsky-blue stone can draw out the properties required\nto forge a Feather Ball.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1684
entries.text: A ball of mud that has become stiff and hard. Hitting a\nPokémon with one may stun the Pokémon, creating an\nopening for you to act.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1686
entries.text: A sea vegetable used for crafting Scatter Bangs. If you\nwrap it up so that the air has no way to escape, then\ndeal it a sharp blow, it produces a loud popping noise.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1687
entries.text: A tuber used for crafting Smoke Bombs. It can be\nmashed for use in cooking, but it can also be dried and\nground to produce a fine powder.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1688
entries.text: An Apricorn that’s had its insides eaten. Hitting a\nPokémon with one may stun the Pokémon, creating an\nopening for you to act.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1689
entries.text: A hard ball made of compressed snow. Hitting a\nPokémon with one may stun the Pokémon, creating an\nopening for you to act.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1690
entries.text: A ball of some kind of sticky substance. Hitting a\nPokémon with one may stun the Pokémon, creating an\nopening for you to act.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1691
entries.text: A glassy black stone that produces a sharp cutting\nedge when split. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1692
entries.text: A block of muddy material that can be used as fuel for\nburning when it is dried. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1693
entries.text: When used in the field, this spray muffles the sound of\nyour footsteps and makes wild Pokémon less likely to\nnotice you for a short time.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1694
entries.text: Required for crafting medicinal compounds. This\nvegetable is found growing across the Hisui region\nand is also known as the wayfarer’s friend.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1695
entries.text: Also called a morning-dew bud. It is used as a material\nfor crafting items that can restore vitality to a Pokémon\nthat has fainted.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1696
entries.text: Extremely spicy but also highly nutritious. This herb is\nused as a material for crafting items that can restore PP\nto Pokémon or boost their stats.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1699
entries.text: A mysterious charm that tends to be lost before any\nother item when you faint in the field. This type of charm\ncomes in five different colors.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1700
entries.text: A mysterious charm that tends to be lost before any\nother item when you faint in the field. This type of charm\ncomes in five different colors.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1701

entries.text: A very spicy condiment that’s indispensable when bread\nis on the table. It pairs tremendously with ketchup.

entries.text: A condiment that unites salty and sweet and also packs a\nrichness that makes bread a delight to eat. The finest\nbutter products are made of 100 percent Moomoo Milk.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1893
entries.text: A very sweet condiment. People in Paldea seem to favor\nthe sweet varieties over the unsweetened.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1894
entries.text: A condiment with a very spicy kick. It’s thanks to\nScovillain that this sauce gets its signature mouth-\ntingling burn.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1895
entries.text: A very salty seasoning, unsurprisingly. People quite\nlike the grains of salt that can be gathered from the\nfootprints of particularly jagged Naclstack.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1896
entries.text: A seasoning packing very spicy flavor. It goes nicely\nwith oilier foods and works especially well when you\nadd just a pinch for a hint of flavor.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1897
entries.text: A condiment that’s very sweet and very sour. It goes\nespecially well with fruit and is easy to incorporate into\na sandwich.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1898
entries.text: A very sweet condiment. Folks in Paldea seem to love\nthe varieties that really let the sweetness sing.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1899
entries.text: A condiment offering very sweet and very tart flavor.\nIt goes well with more ingredients than you’d expect,\nmaking it a convenient go-to.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1900
entries.text: A condiment that’s very sweet and likewise very sour.\nTake care when adding it to sandwiches, as the sweet\nside can overwhelm.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1901
entries.text: A condiment with sour and bitter notes. It’s surprisingly\nuseful, as it makes a nice counterpoint to oilier foods.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1902
entries.text: A condiment offering faint notes of sour and bitter\nflavors. The most prized varieties are the ones Smoliv\nlove the smell of—such oils’ quality is assured.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1903
entries.text: A very sour condiment. Vinegars derived from grapes are\npopular in Paldea. Highly effective when used to add\njust a light note of flavor.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1904
entries.text: A legendary condiment told of only in books. Word has\nit that one taste of its sweet flavor stimulates the\ndigestive system and cures a lack of appetite.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1905
entries.text: One of the condiments spoken of as legends. Its mellow\nsaltiness is said to be tremendously effective when it\ncomes to promoting health.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1906
entries.text: This surpassingly sour condiment is said to be super\neffective in helping the eater recover from exhaustion.\nOnly a scant few people know it exists.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1907
entries.text: A legendary condiment with a deeply bitter taste. It’s\nsaid to dramatically bolster a body’s immune defenses,\nthough that hasn’t been proven.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1908
entries.text: The legendary condiment said to have the mightiest of\nall spicy flavors. It’s said that a single bite will kick the\nmetabolism into high gear immediately.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1909
entries.text: This bitter-tasting ingredient is simple and\nstraightforward—just add it to all kinds of other\ningredients for a delightfully crunchy time.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1910
entries.text: This very tart ingredient has a lot of savory elements\nto it, making it popular with many Pokémon.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1911
entries.text: A very tart ingredient. Some varieties are also very\nsweet, and these are prized above all others by the\npeople of Paldea.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1912
entries.text: A tart and bitter ingredient. Using it together with rich-\ntasting ingredients in a sandwich will really make the\nmost of a cucumber’s fresh-veggie aroma.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1913
entries.text: This very sour ingredient is made by pickling veggies\nin a flavorful brine made from spices and vinegar.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1914
entries.text: This spicy veggie is indispensable to many sandwiches.\nIt goes well with rich ingredients.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1915
entries.text: An ingredient with some sweetness to it. Its spiciness and\nfragrance are milder than those of other onions, making\nit a pleasant bite.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1916
entries.text: An ingredient with some bitterness. When sliced, it adds\na nice accent to a sandwich.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1917
entries.text: An ingredient with some bitterness—but its bitter notes\nand overall flavor are pleasantly mild compared to its\ngreen cousin.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1918
entries.text: An ingredient with some bitterness. It’s not much\ndifferent from its red counterpart in flavor, but mixing\nthe colors makes a feast for the eyes.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1919
entries.text: An ingredient with sweet notes—though its flavor is\nvery mild. The avocado’s richness, however, makes it\nsatisfying to eat.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1920
entries.text: This very salty ingredient has been cooked just shy of\ncharred, making it burst with fragrance and tasty flavor.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1921
entries.text: A very salty ingredient—and that very saltiness is what\nmakes it such a nice companion to veggies.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1922
entries.text: This ingredient is very salty like regular ham, but the\ndifference is prosciutto is not cooked after it is cured,\ngiving it a fun freshness.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1923
entries.text: A very salty and spicy ingredient. This type of sausage\nhas particularly robust salty flavor, and the spicier\nvarieties are extra popular.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1924
entries.text: A very salty and bitter ingredient. The balance between\nthe potent saltiness and the herbs’ bitterness make this\nsausage a pleasure.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1925
entries.text: This very salty ingredient is the thing to add if you want\nto make your sandwich truly filling.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1926
entries.text: A very sweet and salty ingredient. It’s a nutritious\nprocessed food made with a concentrate derived from\nshed Klawf shells.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1927
entries.text: A very salty and bitter ingredient with that unmistakable\nsmoky flavor. It pairs exceptionally well with veggies.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1928
entries.text: When used in a sandwich, this very salty and bitter\ningredient is at its best paired with sour seasonings.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1929
entries.text: An ingredient with a touch of saltiness. It’s full of\nnutrients and can be enjoyed with all sorts of seasonings.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1930
entries.text: A very salty ingredient and a popular dish in Paldea.\nIt’s undeniably filling.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1931
entries.text: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It’s unclear how\nwell this raw block of tofu will serve as a sandwich filling.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1932
entries.text: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It’s unclear how\nwell this cooked rice will serve as a sandwich filling.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1933
entries.text: A nice salty ingredient. It’s unclear how well these boiled\nnoodles will serve as a sandwich filling.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1934
entries.text: This very tart ingredient—a soft salad that’s all about\npotatoes—pairs tremendously well with bread.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1935
entries.text: A very salty ingredient. This thinly sliced cheese is\nperfect for adding to a sandwich.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1936
entries.text: A very sweet ingredient. This go-to fruit is sweet and\nrich, and it’s beloved by many Pokémon.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1937
entries.text: A very tart and sweet ingredient, popular for its ability\nto make a sandwich visually striking.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1938
entries.text: This very sweet ingredient is sliced thin to make it easy\nto add into a sandwich.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1939
entries.text: A very tart ingredient that has a light touch of sweetness\nas well. It goes well with rich ingredients.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1940
entries.text: This very tart ingredient is a fruit of southern lands,\nand its color and texture are a thrill. It’s been cut into\nchunks to be easily manageable.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1941
entries.text: A very spicy ingredient—so spicy as to leave no room\nfor ambivalence about it. You either like it or you don’t.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1942
entries.text: A very spicy condiment. Its distinctive sharp sizzle in\nyour sinuses makes it a good match for rich fillings.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1943
entries.text: A very spicy condiment. Just watch out—use too much\nof this potent seasoning, and it’ll cancel out the other\nflavors.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1944
entries.text: This very spicy condiment seems close to horseradish at\nfirst, but you’ll find that it has a superb flavor all its own.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1945
entries.text: A very bitter ingredient that stands out among veggies\nfor its quirky flavor. People tend to either like it or not\nlike it—they rarely sit on the fence.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_1946
entries.text: A very bitter ingredient that’s quite versatile, as herbs\ngo. It’s fragrant and goes well with tomatoes.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_2549
entries.text: On rare occasions, these shards form when a Tera\nPokémon falls in battle and its Tera Jewel shatters.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_2550
entries.text: A Pecha Berry of the highest quality. It’s said that a\nPecha Berry tree carefully tended by an expert gardener\nwill produce just one of these Berries every few years.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_2551
entries.text: Blueberry Academy’s standard issue tablecloth, made\nwith the latest fiber-processing technology. It’s heat-\nresistant and so tough even a Razor Claw can’t tear it.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_2552
entries.text: A set of chairs that are ideal for picnicking. Their design\nwas inspired by the Blueberry Tablecloth.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_2553
entries.text: A device that synchronizes your mind and feelings\nwith your Pokémon’s so that you can work as one.\nIt’s still a prototype—hence its unrefined appearance.

entries.label: ITEMINFO_2554
entries.text: A rock that fell to earth from space. It’s slightly\nwarm to the touch. It allows a certain species of\nPokémon to change forms.
